# GuruDokAI

> GuruDokAI is an AI assistant for Indonesian teachers that drafts teaching and
> assessment documents (RPP, RPM, RPPM, Modul Ajar, LKPD, TP, ATP, KKTP).
> The site at https://gurudokai.supathub.my.id/ is the product's information
> hub, and also documents four related Android applications for teachers.
> Developer: Ahmad Saoghi, a primary-school teacher in Indonesia. The Android
> applications are published under the Google Play developer account BiraaStudio:
> https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=8704276077631485252

## GuruDokAI (the product)

- Type: desktop application for Windows 10 and Windows 11.
- Audience: teachers at SD, MI, SMP, MTs, SMA, MA, and SMK in Indonesia,
  including madrasah under Kementerian Agama.
- Function: generates draft RPP, RPM, RPPM, Modul Ajar, LKPD, TP, ATP, KKTP, and
  question banks aligned with Indonesian national curriculum documents.
- Language: Indonesian.
- Subscription: Rp19.000 per month, Rp39.900 per 3 months, Rp99.000 per year,
  Rp199.000 lifetime (one-time payment).
- Purchase: https://lynk.id/oghiezr
- Support: WhatsApp +62 851-8953-6359
- About the developer: https://gurudokai.supathub.my.id/tentang/

## Teacher application hub

- [Rekomendasi Aplikasi Guru](https://gurudokai.supathub.my.id/rekomendasi/): hub page listing the applications below.
- [Perbandingan Aplikasi Guru](https://gurudokai.supathub.my.id/rekomendasi/perbandingan-aplikasi-guru/): side-by-side comparison of SiAjar, Rekap Guru, SiUjian, and SiKelas.

### SiAjar

- Page: https://gurudokai.supathub.my.id/rekomendasi/siajar/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.biraastudio.siajar
- Android educational application by BiraaStudio for Indonesian teachers.
- Generates Modul Ajar, TP, ATP, KKTP, Prota, Prosem, assessment documents, and provides PDF tools.
- Free tier: 3 document generations per month. Users may supply their own Gemini or Groq API key, stored locally on the device.
- Premium: Rp19.000 per month, Rp79.000 per 6 months, Rp129.000 per year.
- Not an attendance, grading, or exam application.

### Rekap Guru

- Page: https://gurudokai.supathub.my.id/rekomendasi/rekap-guru/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.BiraaStudio.rekapguru
- Android application for class administration. Main administrative data is stored on the user's phone.
- Manages classes, students, attendance, grade books, teaching journals, memorization records, worship activity records, PDF and Excel reports, and backup/restore files.
- Free access: main class-administration features. Exports for teaching journals, memorization records, and worship activities can be unlocked by completing rewarded ads.
- Premium: a one-time purchase unlocks unlimited classes, PDF and Excel reports, QR cards, data backup, exports without rewarded ads, and attendance recap export. No verified price is published here.
- Bot WhatsApp Otomatis is a separate subscription: Rp10.900 per month, Rp29.900 per 3 months, Rp54.900 per 6 months, Rp99.000 per year.
- A Pulihkan Pembelian button recovers purchases after changing phones or reinstalling.
- Not a document-generation application and not an exam application.

### SiUjian

- Page: https://gurudokai.supathub.my.id/rekomendasi/siujian/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.eduguard.eduguard
- Android secure exam browser that locks student access during supported web-based exams.
- Not a CBT system, not an LMS, and not a question-authoring tool.
- Supported exam platforms: Google Form, Wayground, Kahoot, and other supported web exam platforms.
- Security: teachers create time-limited tokens; students enter a token and take the exam in locked mode. Screenshots and screen recording are blocked using FLAG_SECURE. The app can detect attempts to leave the exam session.
- Monitoring: premium Monitor Ujian shows active students, violation counts, student status, and lock-reset controls, refreshing every 30 seconds.
- Free access: student mode is free permanently. Teacher mode includes 1 token per day for 2 hours; a rewarded ad grants 1 additional token after the free quota.
- Premium: Rp99.000 one-time for unlimited tokens, Monitor Ujian, token duration up to 4 weeks, complete penalty levels, and no ads.
- Data scope: SiUjian does not create, manage, or store exam questions, does not store exam answers, and does not collect student identities for exam purposes.

### SiKelas

- Page: https://gurudokai.supathub.my.id/rekomendasi/sikelas/
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.biraastudio.sikelas
- Android classroom-management application by BiraaStudio for Indonesian schools.
- Not a full LMS, grading application, CBT system, question-authoring tool, or class-administration application like Rekap Guru.
- Roles: one application provides role-specific views for Teacher, Student, and Parent, covering primary through vocational-secondary levels.
- Class access: members join a teacher's class with a 6-digit class code, without an email-and-password joining process. A recovery code issued on first joining restores the class account after changing phones.
- Features: class announcements and pinned information, agenda and schedules, collective confirmations, assignments and homework, notifications, absence requests, and the 7 Habits Journal.
- 7 Habits Journal: records waking early, worship, exercise, healthy eating, studying, community participation, and sleeping early. Parents can verify their child's journal. This is not a health or psychological assessment.
- Data scope: data is used for class features and is not displayed outside class members.
- Access: students and parents use SiKelas free. Teacher Premium costs Rp119.000 per year and adds printable PDF class and per-student habit reports, detailed habit analytics, longer data history, and more active classes.
